name: Ten ni Takaku Chi ni Fukaku
source:
Tokyo, 2019.
After the earthquake city decays, and capital gets transferred. In the empty streets there is a 150 meters height skyscraper that stays unmanned. Eight young people get an invitation to gather in this unique location. Somehow, they decide to stay here. Why do they choose something that has lost its meaning?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
东京，2019年。
地震过后，城市逐渐衰败，首都也被迁往别处。空荡街道之间，矗立着一栋高达150米、无人使用的摩天大楼。八名年轻人收到邀请，前往这个独特地点集合。不知为何，他们决定留在这里。为什么要选择一个已经失去意义的地方？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
